technology_name: Point-of-Care Prognostic Device for Dengue Severity
problem_solved: Absence of reliable early-stage prognostic tools to predict severe dengue progression, causing massive clinical uncertainty and high rates of unnecessary hospitalizations.
description: A lateral flow-based point-of-use prognostic device driven by machine learning insights to predict dengue severity early in the febrile phase. Instead of detecting viral antigens or antibodies to confirm infection, this device identifies and quantifies specific endothelial-derived host proteins discovered via machine learning algorithms to be differentially expressed in patients tracking toward severe complications (e.g., plasma leakage, organ dysfunction). This portable strip format tests serum or plasma samples at the frontline to enable early risk stratification before visible clinical deterioration occurs.
applications:
• Frontline clinical diagnostics in primary health centers and outbreak zones

• Manufacturing of rapid lateral flow prognostic test strips and reader devices

• Strategic supply chains for emergency medical services and resource-limited clinics

• Integration into digital healthcare triage systems and telemedicine diagnostic networks
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Digital Technologies, AI & Software
